name: Sopronkövesd (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of light blue over white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Sopronkövesd (a red shield with a white castle and a bunch of grapes) above the name SOPRONKÖVESD in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
